name: What is the process for garage trim installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for garage trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The garage trim installation process typically involves several steps: initial inspection and measurement, removal of old trim if necessary, surface preparation, cutting and fitting new trim pieces, secure attachment, and finishing touches such as caulking and painting or sealing. Our team ensures proper sealing to prevent water intrusion and leaves the work area clean upon completion. We prioritize precise measurements and secure fastening for a durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: The installation process includes inspection, old trim removal, surface preparation, cutting and fitting new trim, secure attachment, and finishing work.
